**How the game works.** The game runs in real time and is divided into turns of 30 seconds. In each turn you see what has happened since your last turn, and then you decide what to do during the next 30 seconds. In one turn you can:

- **Search** for clues by typing up to 1 search terms. Searches should be single words, so type "Smith" instead of "Mr. Smith". You can search the same keyword more than once to find more clues. Writing a message takes time: in a turn in which you send a message with your own text (including a reply), you cannot search.
